simple.summary: עֶכֶס (ʻekeç) means a fetter ; hence, an anklet First listed occurrence: Isa 3 18.

definitions.full: H5914. ekes [ עֶ֫כֶס ] noun [masculine] anklet, bangle ; — plural absolute הָעֲכֶסִים Isa 3:18 bangles, anklets (as ornaments); for singular absolute ׳ע Prov 7:22 read עֵגֶל Toy.
